articles.title: PSLV C62 mission: ISRO set to launch Earth Observation Satellite on January 12, check time, specifications, partner countries & other details
articles.summary: ISRO is launching its PSLV C62 mission on January 12, marking the start of its 2026 launch calendar. The mission will deploy the EOS-N1 earth observation satellite, alongside 14 other payloads. This highlights India's robust space program, providing vital data for various national applications and showcasing advanced indigenous technological capabilities for future strategic deployments.

articles.title: 20 Air Force officers believed to be involved in 'yeye' culture, says RMAF chief
articles.summary: Around 20 Royal Malaysian Air Force (RMAF) officers in Kuala Lumpur are reportedly involved in "yeye culture," a term for immoral activities. RMAF chief Jeneral Datuk Seri Muhamad Norazlan Aris confirmed initial findings. This incident, implicating military personnel in misconduct, highlights concerns regarding discipline and ethical standards within the armed forces, suggesting potential internal investigations and disciplinary measures for those involved.

articles.title: Tejas Networks Q3 Results: Cons loss widens to Rs 196 crore, revenue sinks 88% YoY
articles.summary: Indian telecom gear manufacturer Tejas Networks reported a consolidated loss of Rs 196.55 crore for the October-December quarter, its second consecutive loss. This was mainly due to lower sales. The financial setback for this domestic player highlights challenges in the competitive telecom equipment manufacturing sector, impacting India's technological self-reliance.
